sidechat.readOnlySidechatParentSessionSe: Read-only Sidechat · Parent session <s0/>. Select complete replies on this page to add to the parent queue. Use the parent queue's Steer action explicitly when needed.
sidechat.updateTheConnectedServerToSend_: Update the connected server to send Sidechat findings.
sidechat.noCompleteSidechatRepliesOnThis: No complete Sidechat replies on this page.
sidechat.selectAtMost20RepliesWithin_7b1: Select at most 20 replies within 256 KiB. Replies are sent in full.
sidechat.sendSelectedFindingsToParentQue: Send selected findings to parent queue
sidechat.theOriginalSelectedMessagesAndR: The original selected messages and revisions are retained while the result is uncertain.
sidechat.selectedFindingsQueuedAsReviewT: Selected findings queued as <s0/>. Review them in the parent queue.
sidechat.retry.label: Retry
sidechat.retry.explanation: Ask the same question again using the parent session's latest completed execution. This keeps the same Side Chat and replaces the displayed answer when complete. Previous answers remain in history.
sidechat.retry.busy: Retry is unavailable while original work, queued input or cleanup is pending. No retry is scheduled.
sidechat.retry.unsupported: Update the server and original Runner Device to retry this text-only Side Chat question.
sidechat.retry.recovery: Keep the original attempt and resolve its recovery and cleanup before retrying.
sidechat.retry.failed: The retry did not complete. The previous answer remains displayed.
sidechat.retry.uncertain: Acceptance is unconfirmed. Check only the original request; do not create another retry.
sidechat.retry.retainedHistory: Earlier answers keep their original execution and usage. Findings already sent to the parent are unchanged.
